title: A host MCP server embeds the kb over stdio
goal: Another MCP server (such as a TypeScript server already hosted for Copilot Studio) can spawn python3 _tools/kb_mcp.py as a stdio child and re-expose kb_pack, kb_search and kb_show: kb_mcp.py --roots limits the served roots without changing the default the plugin uses, a contract test fails when those three tools' names, input schemas or the server instructions change without a fixture update and a VERSION bump, and kb/_self/embedding.md is the contract (command, environment, roots, tools to pass on, carrying the kb's instructions and none rule into the host's own tool descriptions, updating on census tags)
notes: The operator's TypeScript server reaches the kb over stdio: no network hop and no authentication between them; the host needs Python 3.11+ and a clone at a census tag.
